scope: Require retained binary to new-runtime QSV-OFF exact output proof before same-candidate QSV-OFF to ON proof.

Mandatory target identity associates raw EL evidence with actual capture host/GPU. Scalar adapter requires independently observed private input, executable, runtime, resource and before/after identity checks; it does not itself collect those observations.

Same-candidate proof additionally requires exact active P010 EL sample and storage-code equality, zero low bits, matching source/colour/chroma/geometry/PTS, actual mapped route and FEL residual metadata.
Decoder mapping/pairing and renderer preparation/native-input intervals are validated independently; they are not equated or labelled HDMI frames.
Initial isolated Profile7 SPR180 scene, unchanged base decoder, QSV async_depth1, same packed route and explicit planar0/1; both scheduling optimizations OFF.
Performance configuration disables capture readback, requires restored matched subtitle state and substantial actual CPU/GPU interval coverage.
Thin additive observer changes only two known log-marker lists in memory; existing observer file is not edited.
Existing lifecycle checks establish normal process shutdown, not clean Dolby display restoration.

Accuracy proof schema is a strict consumer; actual binary/runtime/source identity and raw frame evidence must be produced by the future approved captures/probe. No empirical QSV preservation report has been generated by these mock tests.
